Bug_Explanation: The empty finalize method serves no purpose and should be removed. The Java Language Specification has declared Object.finalize() as deprecated since JDK 9.

This finalizer method is empty and does not perform any actions, leading to the finalization of the object when it is no longer referenced. This is not how finalizers are supposed to be used and could lead to unpredictable behavior.
